purpose: Plan a rail trip; teach 鉄道/名古屋/福岡/滞在/欧州/ニューヨーク/カナダ/イスラエル

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今回は鉄道で西へ行こう。
lines.en: This time let’s go west by rail.
lines.style: planning friend proposing a route, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 名古屋で一泊して、福岡まで？
lines.en: Stay a night in Nagoya, then to Fukuoka?
lines.style: engaged friend mapping the legs, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: いいね。福岡には何日滞在する？
lines.en: Nice. How many days do we stay in Fukuoka?
lines.style: organizing friend checking duration, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 三日くらいゆっくりしたい。
lines.en: I want about three relaxed days.
lines.style: friend setting the pace, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 海外だと、欧州は遠いもんね。
lines.en: For abroad, Europe is far, after all.
lines.style: friend comparing with overseas, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ニューヨークも憧れるけど、予算が…。
lines.en: I long for New York too, but the budget…
lines.style: friend tempering with reality, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: カナダやイスラエルは、また今度ね。
lines.en: Canada and Israel are for another time.
lines.style: friend deferring the big trips, each word carrying genuine natural feeling
